Instrument / evidence: Parallel standards-aligned assessment with domain subscores
Primary analysis: Paired mean change, 95% CI, paired effect size; item/domain diagnostics
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register a positive-change gate and minimum domain coverage; do not use normalized gain as the sole statistic

Instrument / evidence: Two common performance tasks: e.g., risk/control analysis and network/incident task
Primary analysis: Rubric means, proficiency rate, revision gain; double-score a sample
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register proficiency standard and acceptable inter-rater reliability

Instrument / evidence: Parallel knowledge form plus selected repeated task elements
Primary analysis: Delayed score and retained proportion of post-minus-pre gain
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register an acceptable retention range and report uncertainty

Instrument / evidence: Novel scenario with changed surface features requiring method selection and justification
Primary analysis: Analytic rubric: representation, evidence, method choice, mitigation, justification
Decision rule guidance: Require reasoning and adaptation; do not count a rehearsed replica as transfer

Instrument / evidence: Authorization/privacy scenario items; lab compact; incident and near-miss log
Primary analysis: Decision accuracy, violations, near misses, corrective actions
Decision rule guidance: Zero unauthorized targeting; every near miss reviewed and closed

Instrument / evidence: Brief validated or carefully piloted scales plus open response
Primary analysis: Change and subgroup patterns; reliability of scale
Decision rule guidance: Secondary outcome only; never substitute for knowledge/performance

Instrument / evidence: Attendance, lesson completion, attempts, revisions, time-on-task
Primary analysis: Rates, distributions, relationship to learning outcomes
Decision rule guidance: Use diagnostically; high engagement without learning is not success

Instrument / evidence: Preparation minutes, troubleshooting minutes, support contacts, confidence, fidelity checklist
Primary analysis: Median and trend by module; completion and deviation reasons
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register a sustainable prep/support target after initial onboarding

Instrument / evidence: Login, launch, reset, blocked traffic, device failure, uptime, IT escalation
Primary analysis: Launch success, failure rate, time lost, root-cause categories
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register launch and uptime targets; no unresolved critical security issue

Instrument / evidence: Access failures, accommodations, equivalent-path use, subgroup growth and experience
Primary analysis: Disaggregated outcomes with small-cell suppression; missingness review
Decision rule guidance: No systematic access barrier; equivalent path must preserve the learning objective

Instrument / evidence: Completed standards map, checklist evidence, safety/privacy artifacts, version register
Decision rule guidance: No marketing or approval claim while a stop condition remains unresolved

Instrument / evidence: Licenses, devices, PD/support hours, IT setup, reusable effort, cost per completer
Primary analysis: Total and marginal cost; sensitivity by class size and lab mode
Decision rule guidance: Pre-register acceptable total cost and support burden for scale
